mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome—I'm glad you're here. You know, have you ever wondered what it really takes to break away from the ordinary and spark something truly original? Originality is all about having the courage to question what everyone else accepts, and the willingness to champion fresh ideas—even when they might seem a little out there at first. Together, we're about to step into the world painted by Adam M. Grant in his book, Originals: How Non-Conformists Move the World. This journey pulls back the curtain on the minds and habits of people who dare to think differently—those non-conformists who end up driving real progress and innovation, not just in business, but across cultures and communities. And let's be honest—the path for original thinkers is almost never a straight line. It's a mix of risk, resilience, and seeing opportunity where others might only see roadblocks. Throughout this story, we’ll see how challenging the norm and embracing creative dissent can spark changes that ripple out far beyond just one person—sometimes transforming entire organizations or even society itself. As we explore vivid stories and dive into some fascinating research, we'll uncover what really sets these non-conformists apart. From that first spark of a new idea, to the practical moves it takes to turn it into reality, we're going to talk about balancing risk and caution, getting the timing right, and why having the right allies by your side can make all the difference. Along the way, we'll meet entrepreneurs, activists, and everyday folks who show us the many paths to making a lasting mark. So, if you've ever wanted to understand how originality works—and how you, too, can become a force for meaningful change—you're in the right place. Let's dive in and discover what it takes to move the world.
